slides.s: Here's how to find yours with AI in about 10 minutes.
Go to AnnualCreditReport.com. All 3 bureaus, free every week. It's the official site.

slides.t: Before you upload anything to AI, black out your Social Security number and account numbers. It doesn't need them to find errors.

slides.p: Read my credit report. List anything that looks wrong: accounts I may not have opened, late payments, wrong balances or duplicates. Explain each one in plain English.
Write a short, factual dispute letter to [bureau] about [item]. Ask them to investigate and correct it under the Fair Credit Reporting Act.

slides.s: Credit bureaus generally must investigate a dispute within 30 days. Dispute online or by certified mail, and save everything you send.
Step by step guide and dispute letter templates, free in your DMs.
